title: Archive through December 5, 2003 - Anonymous (Tuesday, November 11, 2003 - 04:45 pm)
content: I was two or three months old only when my heart stopped beating. All went calm, soft and dark and I felt more than fine. I felt at peace. Then suddenly the doctors or staff started giving me a heart massage and it hurt so much. I wanted them to stop. And then I was back and I didn’t feel fine anymore.
